@graph.name: Wild Lake Studio
@graph.description: Wild-Lake keeps the method honest. Wild Lake Studio is a brutalist talent architecture and structural design studio. It scouts raw creative capability and builds systems around it, across songs, scripts, and major bodies of work. It formalizes a fifteen-year independent practice of guiding developing artists. Created within Lab 783 as its research laboratory, Wild-Lake is the home of the Talent Architecture practice: advisory on a retainer or fixed project fee, covering artist development, A&R, and creative infrastructure. It takes no ownership or percentage of an artist's work. Wild-Lake also partners with record labels, galleries, and booking agencies. Every engagement begins with the artist's willing participation, whether they approach directly or through a representative. Not for sale.

@graph.name: Food API
@graph.description: Food API is a food-systems venture developed by Lab 783, available for acquisition and development. Its core specification connects chef networks, neighborhood needs, and meal-platform operations. It maps how chef and meal records, local economic and dietary constraints, hub capacity, pricing, and delivery coverage could work together. Chef-driven artistry under hyper-local constraints is the guiding principle: design food systems around the economic, cultural, and dietary realities of specific ZIP codes and neighborhoods. Food API provides a proposed architecture for a buyer to develop into a product or evaluate for integration into an existing food business. Current stage: specification. Not deployed.
@graph.slogan: Food systems architecture connecting chef networks, neighborhood needs, and meal-platform operations.
